title: Stasis & Reflection
description: A woman in a green dress sits at a marble desk in a purple room, holding a glowing blue potion bottle. An ornate mirror reflects her and the room, which features hanging colorful glass potion bottles, two hourglasses on the desk, an open book titled 'LOVED POISON', and framed paintings of a mysterious library hallway.
prompt: A woman in a dark green velvet dress sits at an ornate marble desk in a deep purple mystical room, reaching for a glowing blue potion bottle while another sits under a glass cloche next to two hourglasses. An arched mirror reflects the entire scene including hanging colorful glass potion bottles on chains from the ceiling. On the desk lies an open book with visible text 'LOVED POISON'. Framed paintings of endless magical library hallways hang on the wall. The atmosphere is filled with floating sparkles and cracked textures, in a detailed surreal fantasy style.
